result:
**Round 168 (V-3c-4b): PASS.** I found no bugs. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true: every check that can run in the cloud ran in real Chromium on `/studio-lab` at 1440×900 and 1280×720. One sub-check is blocked: the fake-Bearer 403 needs the backend, which isn't available in the cloud.

- **Tests and source:**
  - My run of A's 12 test files gave 251/251, including the new LSU7 and UM11 checks and the updated TH10 check.
  - HEAD is `1fef377` and the 980 frozen files match.
  - The only changes are the 6 allowed files plus the new doc 137. Protected files are untouched, and nothing changed during my phase.
- **Diff review:** I read the diff myself. Only class strings changed, exactly as the task lists.
  - On-state strings changed only by the allowed hover/press additions.
  - The mixed Solo string is identical to before.
  - The video-import buttons match the Export look.
  - The only arbitrary values are the 4 motion tokens.
  - The theme test changes exactly one value; the other two test files only add checks.
- **Layout:** nothing moved by any measurable amount (0.000 px) on any button, in any of the 5 states, at either viewport.
  - The full-page layout comparison against round 167 found no missing or added elements and no movement.
  - The set of elements failing contrast is the same as in round 167.
- **Looks:**
  - Off buttons: transparent 1 px border, 5 % fill, 8 px corners, 180 ms transition.
  - On buttons keep their fill on hover and press.
  - Mixed Solo looks the same as before at rest (pixel rgb(29,26,23)); on hover its right half shows the 8 % fill (rgb(45,41,38)).
  - With reduced motion on, these buttons have no transition, including the full import button.
- **Contrast** (rest / hover):
  - Lane buttons off: 5.98 / 12.35.
  - Group buttons off: 5.57 / 11.46.
  - On buttons: 8.32.
  - Import button: 7.05 / 6.58.

  No enabled button is below 4.5:1.
- **Function, measured on the real audio output:**
  - Lane Mute, lane Solo and group Mute silence the sound within about 80–100 ms, and the sound returns when undone.
  - Group Solo goes to mixed when one member is soloed, then on, then off.
  - Both video-import buttons open the file picker. A real video lands on the video lane and its picture shows in the dock.
  - Fold, name selection with Ctrl+click, pan reset, and rename with Undo all work.
- **Access:** `/studio-lab` opens anonymously with the demo badge. `/studio/middle-east` asks the user to sign in and loads no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401.

My first layout run at 1440 was the cold first page load; it showed the known hydration warning and "Invalid hook call". I replaced it once, which the rules allow, and recorded it as an invalid run.

Notes for B, not bugs:
- **Q-R167-ON-HOVER:** I confirmed in the browser that on-state Mute and Solo don't change on hover or press. This stays a question for Saba.
- **Fold, name and pan-reset buttons:** they keep an older 150 ms transition even with reduced motion on. That was already the case and is outside this round.
- **Faint fill:** the 5 % fill is very faint against its background (1.12–1.13:1). This is the spec's known trade-off.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- c-round-168.md
- c-round-168.json
- c-round-168/
